description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh:
多云的code。取值：
- qcloud：腾讯云。
- aliyun：阿里云。
- hcloud：华为云。
description.en:
The code of the cloud service provider. Valid values:

- qcloud: Tencent Cloud.

- aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.

- hcloud: Huawei Cloud.

description.zh:
数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。
可调用[DescribeDataSourceInstance](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854&activeTabKey=api|DescribeDataSourceInstance)获取数据源ID。
description.en: The ID of the data source. The ID is an MD5 hash that is calculated based on the values of other parameters. You can call the [DescribeDataSourceInstance](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CDescribeDataSourceInstance) operation to obtain the data source ID.
The name of the data source.
The parameters of the data source, in a JSON array format.
The description of the data source.

description.zh:
数据源类型。取值：
- ckafka：腾讯云ckafka。
- obs：华为云obs。
- wafApi：腾讯云waf攻击日志下载API。
description.en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- ckafka: Tencent Cloud CKafka.

- obs: Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS).

- wafApi: the API used to download attack logs from Tencent Cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF).

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region where the Data Management center of the threat analysis feature is located. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem modify-data-source --account-id 123xxxxxx --data-source-type obs --data-source-instance-id 220ba97c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca328d7ea --data-source-instance-name beijing_waf_kafka --data-source-instance-remark waf_alert_log --data-source-instance-params paraCode_:_region_code_,_paraValue_:_ap-guangzhou --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloud-siem ModifyDataSource --region cn-hangzhou --CloudCode hcloud --AccountId 123xxxxxx --DataSourceInstanceParams 'paraCode_:_region_code_,_paraValue_:_ap-guangzhou' --DataSourceType obs --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DataSourceInstanceName beijing_waf_kafka --DataSourceInstanceRemark waf_alert_log --DataSourceInstanceId 220ba97c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca328d7ea
